job.name: cover_returns_16x9
job.person_note: The presenter must be exactly the person from the second attached photo.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching video COVER (YouTube/Reels thumbnail) for an example video of an AI video production service, built EXACTLY in the design system «Графит и красный» from the FIRST attached board: graphite #23262B, signal red #E3342F, white, light grey; condensed bold Oswald-like headlines; red diagonal stripes. The presenter is the store administrator woman from the SECOND attached photo (same face and hair, graphite shirt with red accents) — photorealistic, the same person, cut out and integrated into the graphic design. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text on the cover: a small pill label «Обучение персонала» and a big title in two lines «Возврат товара» / «за 4 шага». No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements. High contrast, readable at small size, modern and premium.
job.style_qa: обложка ролика в стиле приложенного борда, ведущий из приложенного фото узнаваем и не искажён, надписи «Обучение персонала» и Возврат товара за 4 шага без ошибок, другого текста нет
job.prompt: Horizontal layout: the presenter on one side (waist-up, large, looking at the viewer), the title block on the other side, the key visual between or behind them; keep ALL text and the face inside the central 80% of the HEIGHT (top and bottom 10% may be cropped later). Key visual: a shop checkout counter with a returned item box and a receipt, clean modern retail interior.
